scope: One observation batch per current effect until ALL siblings settle; individual throw/rejection retains failed record. Same 5s interval, no automatic immediate extra retry, no transport argument/authority change.
limits: A key replacement can leave physically pending old transport reads because the API has no abort signal. Cancelled effect results cannot apply. This is not global cross-effect cancellation or native/provider acceptance.
environment: Scrubbed; kernel network denied; private HOME/TMPDIR/cache; filesystem writes allowed only in fresh private directory.
